claim_under_review.text: A cube's six face-normals, projected, sit at even angular intervals. That is the mechanical reason a cube generates a regular polygon.

found_by: external review (ChatGPT collapse session), which flagged it as an overclaim

verification.method: project the six face normals (±1,0,0),(0,±1,0),(0,0,±1) onto each coordinate plane
verification.result: every plane keeps 4 distinct directions at 90 deg and collapses 2 normals to the origin
verification.verdict: FALSE — a cube's face normals never project to a regular hexagon

ruling.text: The radial 6-sector chart is a CHOSEN arrangement of six identities, not a geometric consequence of the cube.
ruling.consequence: A six-facet canon can carry several compatible charts (radial / cube-net / six-panel), each needing its own adjacency and orientation metadata. The cube is one carrier among several, not the canonical one.
ruling.why_it_mattered: The original claim smuggled a chart in as a law, which would have made the cube look canonical by derivation.

action_taken: Synthesis doc amended in place with the correction and the verified arithmetic. No file deleted. No history rewritten.
next: Any other geometry asserted in the synthesis must name its derivation or be withdrawn.
